ownership_summary: Boursa Kuwait-listed since 20 Oct 2003. The H1 2026 statements name United Gulf Bank B.S.C. as Parent Company and KIPCO as Ultimate Parent. UGB has been 100% owned by Burgan Bank since 2025, so Kamco is an indirect Burgan subsidiary (63.01% effective interest in Burgan's FY2025 accounts). Kamco's Facts page lists KIPCO Group Companies (United Gulf Bank, Burgan Bank) at 62.92% (disclosure dated 16 Dec 2019) and Alpha Group Holding Co. (Ibrahim Abdulrahman Alasfoor & Group) at 11.03% (disclosure dated 8 Sep 2026). On 21 Sep 2026 the board recommended renaming the company 'Burgan Capital Investment Company'. As of 12 Oct 2026 this was still subject to General Assembly approval and regulatory/legal procedures, and no meeting date had been announced.

group_structure: Kamco Investment Company K.S.C.P. is owned by United Gulf Bank B.S.C. (Bahrain; to be renamed Burgan Bank Bahrain), which Burgan Bank K.P.S.C. has owned 100% since 2025. Burgan is in turn a KIPCO subsidiary. Kamco's main subsidiaries (effective Burgan-group interests at 31 Dec 2025, from Burgan's FY2025 note) are: First Securities Brokerage Company (Oula Wasata, brokerage, Kuwait), KAMCO Investment Company (DIFC) Limited, KAMCO Investment Company - Saudi Arabia (Kamco Invest - Saudi), Manafee Investment Company (Bahrain), Nawasi United Holding, GCC Tech Invest (Jersey), Kamco European Logistics (Luxembourg) and consolidated funds (Kuwait Private Equity Opportunities Fund, KAMCO Global Fund, KAMCO Mena Plus Fixed Income Fund). The brokerage network also lists Global Investment House Jordan. DOUBLE COUNTING: Kamco's balance sheet (KWD 145.8m total assets at 30 Jun 2026) is consolidated in Burgan Bank's group totals (kw-burgan), so do not add it to Burgan's. Kamco's AUM (USD 18.0bn) is client assets held off balance sheet and is the Burgan group's main AUM figure; count it once only.

capabilities.wealth_summary: Kamco Invest is a Kuwaiti asset manager, investment bank and broker with USD 18.0bn AUM at 30 Jun 2026 (USD 16.5bn at end-2025). Fees made up 82.8% of H1 2026 revenue, and management fees on AUM were KWD 5.0m in H1 2026. Wealth management is led by MD Sana Al-Hadlaq and serves HNW clients, family offices and institutions. Asset management offers preset portfolio strategies (equity, fixed income, balanced, annuity, capital guaranteed), custom mandates and public funds: Kamco Investment Fund, Kamco Islamic Fund, Kamco Premier Market Index Fund, plus the Shariah-compliant Kamco Freestyle Saudi Equity Fund and Kamco SAR Murabaha Fund launched in 2025. Alternatives include real estate, private equity, private credit and leasing structured products, and a EUR 300m Shariah-compliant European real-estate-finance partnership with Santander Alternative Investments (H1 2026). The Kamco Invest App provides digital onboarding, funding and mutual-fund subscriptions with periodic investment plans. Brokerage runs through First Securities Brokerage (Oula Wasata), which offers e-trading. Since 2025 Kamco has been Burgan Bank's group product factory for private banking, and on 21 Sep 2026 its board recommended renaming it Burgan Capital Investment Company.

private_banking.detail: Not a bank. Wealth management for HNW individuals and family offices is offered (see advisory/discretionary); Burgan Bank provides private banking to the group's clients.

asset_management.detail: USD 18.0bn AUM (30 Jun 2026). Equity and fixed income portfolio management and funds. Three public funds have performance listed to Sep 2026: Kamco Investment Fund (six LSEG Lipper awards), Kamco Islamic Fund and Kamco Premier Market Index Fund; KSA: Kamco Freestyle Saudi Equity Fund, Kamco SAR Murabaha Fund (launched 2025). DIFC and Saudi subsidiaries are growing asset management. Forbes ME ranked CEO Faisal Sarkhou among the top 10 Middle East asset managers in 2026.

brokerage.detail: First Securities Brokerage Company (Oula Wasata), Kuwait, with electronic trading attracting institutional and individual clients in H1 2026. Global Investment House Jordan. A 'Trade Online' link points to kamco.globaltradingnetwork.com. Kamco Invest - Saudi launched a securities lending service with HSBC Saudi Arabia (28 Jul 2026).

digital_investing.detail: Kamco Invest App: fully digital onboarding, funding, interactive dashboard and subscription to Kamco mutual funds, including periodic (regular) investment plans. The page does not mention equities or third-party products in the app. Online trading via the brokerage platform (S16).

advisory.detail: Wealth management offers 'tailor-made investment solutions & integrated services' and client advisory (official bio of MD Wealth Management). A Director of Investment Advisory role is noted in the original workbook (unverified).

discretionary.detail: Portfolio management with preset strategies (equity, fixed income, balanced, annuity, capital guaranteed) and custom mandates with customised guidelines and benchmarks.

model_portfolios_robo.detail: Preset portfolio-management strategies function as model portfolios (equity, fixed income, balanced, annuity, capital guaranteed); no robo-advice found.

funds_platform.detail: Only Kamco's own funds are evidenced (website, app). No third-party fund shelf or platform provider found.

structured_products.detail: Capital-protected and yield-enhanced structured products, incl. private credit and leasing, through partnerships with international asset managers. H1 2026: third distribution from a leasing strategy with a New York Life-affiliated manager (name transliterated in the Arabic report).

private_markets.detail: Alternative investments (MD Mohammed Al Othman): real estate funds, private equity (e.g. Kuwait Private Equity Opportunities Fund), European logistics and GCC tech vehicles; USD 82.0m distributed to investors in 2025; EUR 300m partnership with Santander Alternative Investments for Shariah-compliant European private real estate finance (H1 2026).

discrepancies.detail: H1 2026 note 1 describes UGB as 'a subsidiary of KIPCO', whereas Burgan's FY2025 statements show UGB 100% owned by Burgan Bank (itself a KIPCO subsidiary).
discrepancies.resolution: Both are consistent with KIPCO as ultimate parent; the chain is Kamco <- UGB <- Burgan <- KIPCO.

open_items: Kamco Invest news articles (node pages), research PDFs and the Annual Report 2025 PDF are behind a Cloudflare bot-check or return 403; they were not bypassed. Listing pages and static pages were read in the browser.
The official H1 2026 results release (node/42640) was not opened; AUM USD 18.0bn at 30 Jun 2026 is taken from Al Jarida's report of that release.
Burgan Capital rename: no General Assembly date or approval found as of 12 Oct 2026. Check Boursa Kuwait for an EGM notice.
FY2025 audited statements not opened: confirm total income vs 'total operating revenue' (KD 34m vs KWD 27.5m).
Verify the current roles of Dalal AlShaya, Faisal AlOthman, Omar Zaineddine (possible retitle to Head of Capital Markets) and Talal Al-Yaqoub.
Number of Kamco Invest App users and investing clients not found.
The relationship with Global Trading Network (Trade Online platform domain) is not described; confirm the execution/front-end vendor for online trading.
Board page lists five directors (Talal Al Sabah, Abdullah Nasser Al-Sabah, Sheikha Dana Nasser Al-Sabah, Samer Abbouchi, Haya Boodai); only the Chair and Vice Chair are recorded as people.
